name: witgraph-loader
description: Runs witgraph graphs in a browser or Node: jco-transpiled nodes under the witgraph scheduler, with hooks for debugging and simulation

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p witgraph-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir ../../target && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/witgraph_web.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:addr2line: cargo build --release -p witgraph-web --features addr2line --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir ../../target && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/witgraph_web.wasm
scripts.build:wasm64: cargo +nightly build --release -p witgraph-web --target wasm64-unknown-unknown -Zbuild-std=std,panic_abort --target-dir ../../target && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm64-unknown-unknown/release/witgraph_web.wasm
